messages.subject: Potential bug with ggplot2
parts:
Hello there,

I'm running R v.3.2.4 and ggplot2 v.2.1.0 and I keep getting the following error message when I attempt to display my plot:
" Error in FUN(X[[i]], ...) : 
  Theme element 'text' has NULL property: margin, debug"

The same code worked seamlessly the last time I ran it, so I'm guessing I've messed something up by updating R or ggplot2. The code itself is below, any feedback you have would be VERY MUCH APPRECIATED!

########## PULLING UP DATA ########## 
# Scatterplot depicting the overall pattern of results by group #
setwd('~/Box Sync/Winter_2016/Papers/Paper_Alexithymia_RewardValuation/Data/')
dat = read.csv('Alex_Reward_rework.csv') 
######### PLOTTING THE DATA  ########## 
# COLOR BLIND PALETTE FOR GGPLOTS #
cbbPalette = c("#009E73","#E69F00","#000000","#56B4E9","#F0E442","#0072B2","#D55E00","#CC79A7")
 
#stats for barplot 1
difDat = ddply(dat, c("grpAI"), summarise,
                N = length(unique(WHIS_ID)),
                mean = mean(zIdf),
                sd   = sd(zIdf),
                se   = sd / sqrt(N)
 )
difDat$grpAI = mapvalues(difDat$grpAI, from = c("4", "3", "2", "1"), to = c("ctrl", "0%", "<15%",">15%"))
#barplot 1
 difFig = ggplot(difDat,aes(x=factor(grpAI,levels=c("ctrl", "0%", "<15%",">15%")),mean,fill=grpAI)) +
   geom_bar(colour="black",position=position_dodge(),stat="identity") +
   geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=mean-se, ymax=mean+se),
                 width=0.2,
                 position=position_dodge(0.9)) +
   theme(legend.position="none") + 
   scale_fill_brewer(palette="Set1") + xlab("Anterior Insula Damage") + ylab("Difficulty Identifying Feelings (Z-score)") +
   background_grid(major = "xy", minor = "none") +
   labs(title="A") + 
   theme(plot.title=element_text(vjust=1,hjust=-0.15,size=24)) + 
   ylim(-1.5,1.5)
